meta.display_name: Wiley Online Library journals (general author guidelines)
meta.status_detail: Round 1 (workspace proposal 3674c0c1) migration. Verified 2026-09-11 against onlinelibrary.wiley.com author-guidelines pages, general policy plus a representative per-journal figure example (Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences) for the line-art DPI floor -- Wiley journals vary their own artwork instructions per title, so figure_dpi_minimum_line_art is representative, not universal, rather than a blanket cross-Wiley figure.

source.quote: references may be submitted in any style or format, as long as it is consistent throughout
source.note: An explicit defers-to-the-individual-journal fact for most Wiley journals -- some journal families (e.g. chemistry/materials science) do have a house numbered style, but that is the exception this pass found, not the general rule.
Applies to Supporting Information once posted online.

source.citation: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences (a representative single Wiley journal's artwork guidance page, not a blanket cross-Wiley page)
source.note: Drawn from one representative journal's guidance rather than a blanket cross-Wiley figure -- Wiley journals vary their own artwork instructions per title, so this floor is representative, not universal.
